text: I was searching for wisdom tooth extraction reviews near Chaeng Wattana and found this clinic. It's conveniently located near my workplace and dorm, so I contacted them via Line for details. The Line admin was excellent – ​​quick, concise, and complete information. I could even schedule an appointment via Line, and they called to confirm one day before my appointment. The clinic is located in front of Plum Condo and has parking. I was impressed from the moment I walked in. The clinic was incredibly clean and refreshing. They had an air purifier and self-service drinking water. The staff approached me, explained the treatment details, and asked if I was ready to have my wisdom tooth extracted that day. They provided a detailed cost breakdown and asked if I needed a medical certificate, which they provided free of charge. I had my wisdom tooth extracted by a female dentist. She was incredibly gentle and fast; she removed the tooth in less than 3 seconds! I even asked if it was already done, lol. The extraction was almost painless and I ate normally the next evening. Overall, I was very impressed with the location, cleanliness, treatment, and cost. P.S. They accept social security insurance without requiring any upfront payment.
